'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 John Veasey DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)|VB2-D-imperialoccupation-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' John Veesey
* '''Deck name:''' AT AT Hustle
* '''Username:''' Veez
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
